channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: IndiGo crisis: Airline cancels 117 flights in Hyderabad, 100 flights in Chennai today
item.description: Thousands of passengers remained stranded due to cancellations. Angry passengers were seen having heated arguments with the IndiGo staff. The Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) stepped up security at the airport as a precautionary measure to prevent any untoward incident.

item.title: Delhi Police bust multi-state scam syndicate with suspected Chinese links
item.description: Technical surveillance helped identify the key directors of the fake firm -- Shivam Singh, a resident of Faizabad in Uttar Pradesh, and Lakshay, a resident of Delhi, the Delhi Police said in its press note. Investigators found that Rs 10.38 lakh from the defrauded amount had been routed through Belcrest-connected accounts.

item.title: Navjot Kaur Sidhu accuses Congress of 'money-driven CM picks'; party hits back, BJP joins row
item.description: Former Congress MLA Navjot Kaur Sidhu has sparked a major controversy by alleging that ₹500 crore is needed to become the Congress Chief Ministerial candidate in Punjab. Her remarks—accusing the party of favouring those who "bring a suitcase of money"—have ignited sharp reactions from both Congress and BJP.

item.title: Rajnath Singh launches 125 BRO projects, vows to strengthen border infra
item.description: The 125 projects launched on Sunday are spread across two Union Territories -- Ladakh and Jammu & Kashmir -- and seven states - Arunachal Pradesh, Sikkim, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, West Bengal and Mizoram.

item.title: Thousands appear for JKAS competitive exam in J&K amid fight cancellation, age relaxation row
item.description: The public service commission decided to go ahead with the competitive exam for J&K civil services despite a request by Chief Minister Omar Abdullah to postpone the exam for a reasonable duration because of the widespread disruption of air services and the issue of age relaxation still pending confirmation.

item.title: Congress' Nehru legacy honour claim falls flat as scrutiny reveals 'insult' to Ambedkar during UPA rule
item.description: What emerges is not merely a debate over history but a struggle for political ownership of Ambedkar's legacy. Sonia Gandhi's recent remarks at the launch of The Nehru Centre India encapsulate Congress' defensive posture. In a lengthy post, she lamented what she described as "systematic attempts" to denigrate Nehru, accusing the ruling establishment of trying to erase his contributions and destroy the foundations of the nation.

item.title: Global events, inflation data, FII trends likely to drive Indian markets this week
item.description: Inflation data, foreign investor activity, crucial policy meetings in the US, and India's ongoing trade negotiations with major global partners are expected to play a central role in determining market direction.

item.title: Goa nightclub fire: CM Pramod Sawant orders probe; general manager arrested
item.description: Sawant, who visited the site early in the morning to assess the damage and review rescue operations, told NDTV that the general manager of the nightclub has been arrested, and an arrest warrant has been issued against the club's owner.

item.title: BJP's Kangana Ranaut dances with rivals Mohua Moitra, Supriya Sule at wedding; netizens react
item.description: A viral video of Kangana Ranaut dancing with Trinamool Congress MP Mahua Moitra and NCP MP Supriya Sule has sparked a heated debate on social media. The trio's dance at the sangeet for Naveen Jindal's daughter's wedding celebrations shows the three politicians letting their hair down and having a blast.
